emails.subject: Receipt for January hobby supplies
emails.body: Thanks for your purchase: one pack of tufts, one bottle of brush soap, and a spare 32mm base bag. Payment was completed at the register.

emails.subject: Thanks for the varnish comparison notes
emails.body: Thanks for bringing the two sealed test bases on Sunday. The satin-vs-matte comparison answered my question, so there is nothing else you need to send.
